body:
> From the review of PR #169 (#144, merged 2026-08-29). None of these blocked the merge; the operator measured the `--bg` premise live (a `--settings` Stop hook fired 4 s after `claude --bg` launch, comment on #144).

## What

1. **Evidence text** (`src/board.js` ~183-187, `src/model.js` ~834-837, `docs/harnesses.md` ~136-142, `docs/wiki/features/hook-install-shapes.md` ~455-467): the "six per-launch sources" table cites the `claude agents` FleetView parser, which runs after `cli_bg_path` returns. The actual `--bg` path is `handleBgFlag → spawnBgSession`: the respawn-flag allowlist keeps `--settings <value>` as a pair and a `{`-leading value passes untouched (traced in 2.1.251). Replace the table with that, and replace the claim "`hkb stats` profile claude sessions proves the launch hooks fired" — since #137 the tick records the session id via `jobSessionUpdate`; the Stop-hook trace is the `.kanban/sessions/<n>-<k>` marker. Give `hkb doctor` a check on that marker for the latest bg attempt if cheap.
2. **`workerHookSettings`** (`src/init.js` ~569): when `hkb` is on the dispatcher's PATH the launch carries bare `hkb hook stop`, but the hook runs under the session daemon's environment, which keeps its own PATH (#150) — so nvm drift moves into the worker session instead of disappearing. Prefer `node "<PKG_ROOT>/bin/hkb.js"` whenever PKG_ROOT is not ephemeral (`isEphemeralPath`); bare `hkb` only as the npx-cache fallback.
3. **Deny-reason nits from #159, parked twice**: `src/hook.js` ~78 `hkb: ${reason}.` double-dots (seen live: "tools.. If the task"); the `--kind capability` sentence is appended to policy denials too — give `decidePermission` a `kind` (`policy` | `capability` | `path`) and append it only for `capability`; `promptingProfiles` (`src/doctor.js` ~546) counts `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` / `--dangerously-skip-permissions` as "will prompt"; `src/model.js` ~721 header still says "explicit allow or deny-with-reason".
4. Nits: `expandLaunch` only handles a bare `{hook_settings}` element (`--settings={hook_settings}` renders `--settings=` when empty) — either support or refuse it; the PR body's "residual-risk note below" does not exist — put the `--shared-hooks` double-fire (Stop nudge drops to one) in `docs/harnesses.md`.

## Done when

- Docs name the measured probe and the respawn-flag path; no mention of the FleetView sources.
- A launch rendered on a machine with a global `hkb` AND a durable PKG_ROOT names `node "<PKG_ROOT>/bin/hkb.js"` (test in `test/harness.test.js`).
- `test/hook.test.js`: deny reason has no double dot; a policy denial carries no capability sentence; a capability denial does.
- `npm run lint && npm test` green; `npm run smoke` (launch text changed).

## Contract

- No hook `allow`; the `whichAttempt` worktree fallback untouched; `--shared-hooks` keeps working.
goal: The launch-line hook docs state the measured --bg evidence and the real forwarding path, the launch names the dispatcher's own bin/hkb.js whenever PKG_ROOT is durable, and the PreToolUse deny reason is clean and scoped by kind
title: Launch-line hooks: cite the real --bg evidence, prefer PKG_ROOT/bin/hkb.js over a bare hkb on the launch, and the deny-reason nits
